title.zh: HBT80-16和电动60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: HBT80-16 prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h and a single height line. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h and three stone rows.
description.zh: HBT80-16 印 110 kW、50 m³/h 和单独的高度行。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h 和三行石子距离。

h1.zh: HBT80-16和电动60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: HBT80-16 and Electric 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. HBT80-16 prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 40 MPa, horizontal 120 m, delivery height 360 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, outlet pressure 35 MPa and three stone rows, including fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. The model string on HBT80-16 is not the Electric 60 name.
directAnswer.zh: HBT80-16 和电动60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。HBT80-16 印 110 kW、50 m³/h、泵送压力 40 MPa、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、出口压力 35 MPa 和三行石子距离，其中细石为 200 m / 600 m。HBT80-16 上的型号字符串不是电动60的名称。

heading.en: Where HBT80-16 and Electric 60 print different values

body.en: Motor power: HBT80-16 prints 110 kW; Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Theoretical output: HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h; Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Dimensions: HBT80-16 prints 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm; Electric 60 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：HBT80-16印 110 kW；电动60印 90 kW。理论输送量：HBT80-16印 50 m³/h；电动60印 40 m³/h。外形尺寸：HBT80-16印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm；电动60印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: HBT80-16 prints cells that Electric 60 does not: Model line HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110; Pumping pressure 40 MPa; Horizontal conveying distance 120 m; Delivery height 360 m; Max. aggregate size 4 cm and below. Electric 60 prints cells that HBT80-16 does not: Max. outlet pressure 35 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.7 m³; Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: HBT80-16有、电动60没有的行：型号行 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110；泵送压力 40 MPa；水平输送距离 120 m；输送高度 360 m；最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below。电动60有、HBT80-16没有的行：最大出口压力 35 MPa；料斗容积 0.7 m³；细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A higher motor kilowatt on HBT80-16 does not copy Electric 60's 600 m fine-stone line. Open /en/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ for HBT80-16 and /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: HBT80-16 的电机千瓦更高，并不能抄走电动60细石行上的 600 m。看HBT80-16请打开 /zh/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/，看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does HBT80-16 print the same motor power as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 prints 110 kW. Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 110 kW。电动60印 90 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT80-16 print the same theoretical output as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h. Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 50 m³/h。电动60印 40 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT80-16 print the same dimensions as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 prints 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Electric 60 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。电动60印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on Electric 60?
question.zh: 为什么电动60没有型号行？

answer.en: The Electric 60 page does not print that label. HBT80-16 prints HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动60这一页没有印这个标题。HBT80-16印的是 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
